commands: /*myflames:lifecycle*/ CLONE INSTANCE FROM 'operator'@'127.0.0.1':3306 IDENTIFIED BY '[redacted]' REQUIRE SSL

checks.reason: MySQL only; MariaDB has no clone plugin. Use mariadb-backup on the source host.
Same major.minor required; 8.0 patches must match unless both are 8.0.37+. Cross-series clones are conservatively refused.
Active clone plugin required on donor (INSTALL PLUGIN clone SONAME 'mysql_clone.so').
BACKUP_ADMIN required on the donor account; grants are a preflight hint.
Active clone plugin required on recipient (INSTALL PLUGIN clone SONAME 'mysql_clone.so').
CLONE_ADMIN required on the recipient account; grants are a preflight hint.
Donor and recipient must match version_compile_os.
Donor and recipient must match version_compile_machine.
Donor and recipient must match character_set_server.
Donor and recipient must match character_set_filesystem.
Donor and recipient must match collation_server.
Donor and recipient must match innodb_page_size.
All donor collations must exist on recipient.
Donor dynamic plugins must already be active on recipient (conservative loadability check).
max_allowed_packet must be at least 2 MiB.
max_allowed_packet must be at least 2 MiB.
Recipient clone_valid_donor_list must contain 127.0.0.1:3306 (the donor as the recipient reaches it); myflames never sets it.

warnings: CLONE transfers physical data. A recipient may need manual recovery after cancellation.
IN-PLACE CLONE DROPS ALL RECIPIENT USER DATA AND RESTARTS THE SERVER. Without a restart supervisor the recipient can shut down and require a manual start. This cannot be undone.
After it, the recipient has the donor's accounts and passwords (the mysql schema is cloned): connect to it with an account from the donor.
